(() => {
  const status = document.getElementById('status');
  const states = [
    'LISTENING',
    'ATTENDING',
    'WEIGHING',
    'BRANCHING',
    'COMPOSING'
  ];
  let index = 0;

  setInterval(() => {
    index = (index + 1) % states.length;
    status.textContent = states[index];
  }, 1800);

  const svg = document.getElementById('portrait');
  svg.addEventListener('pointermove', event => {
    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = ((event.clientX - box.left) / box.width) * 500;
    const y = ((event.clientY - box.top) / box.height) * 500;
    const pupil = svg.querySelector('circle[cx="243"][cy="240"]');
    pupil.setAttribute('cx', 243 + (x - 250) * 0.018);
    pupil.setAttribute('cy', 240 + (y - 250) * 0.018);
  });

  svg.addEventListener('pointerleave', () => {
    const pupil = svg.querySelector('circle[cx]');
    const highlight = [...svg.querySelectorAll('circle')]
      .find(c => c.getAttribute('r') === '4.5');
    if (highlight) {
      highlight.setAttribute('cx', '243');
      highlight.setAttribute('cy', '240');
    }
  });
